lede: Mountain Village Council has a packed Thursday — public hearing on the Metro District's 2027 budget, first readings on the town budget ordinance and the 2026 property tax levy, and a minor subdivision on the land-use side, all in one sitting. Meanwhile, HARC takes up the long-delayed Shandoka Lot redevelopment preliminary reviews at 860 Black Bear Rd on Tuesday, and the Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee meets in special session to rule on lottery exceptions that could determine whether two families close on a Spruce House unit. The gondola reopens for winter on Friday, and the Backcountry Film Fest runs Wednesday and Thursday if you need a reason to get out of the house.
